title_en: Xinyu Company v. Feng Yumei — dispute over a commercial shop sales contract
ruling_gist_en: 1. Pursuant to Article 110 of the Contract Law, where a party in breach requests termination of the contract, while the non-breaching party demands continued performance, if the financial and material resources required for the breaching party to continue performance exceed the benefits that both parties could obtain from performance under the contract, and the contract no longer has the conditions for continued performance, the breaching party may be allowed to terminate the contract in order to balance the interests of both parties. However, the breaching party must bear liability for damages to the other party, so as to ensure that the other party's actual and vested interests are not diminished as a result of the termination.
